literature.headline_zh: 沙粒病毒科本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期沙粒病毒科研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 两种 MACV 毒株均引起与 BHF 一致的严重多系统疾病,常常导致死亡。谱系 III 菌株在两种 NHP 物种中产生一致的致死率,而谱系 VIII 菌株在 AGM 中产生一致的致死率。MACV 株和 NHP 物种的病理学一致,主要累及胃肠道和淋巴系统,中枢神经系统显示 MACV 抗原的变化但广泛传播。空间蛋白质组学表明 MACV 抗原在神经元和浦肯野细胞中最为普遍。多组学评估显示物种之间 BHF 的总体表型相似,但在后期时间点的炎症反应不同。 [10.1128/mbio.02195-26]
VLPdEm5 mRNA-LNP 引发快速、高滴度的结合抗体,在六种主要 LASV 谱系中具有广泛的交叉反应性、强大的生发中心 B 细胞活性和记忆 T 细胞反应。至关重要的是,它提供了针对体内假病毒攻击的剂量依赖性保护。 [10.1016/j.virs.2026.11.018]
调查得出的结论是,对其他人造成的风险较低,该案件归因于该家庭最近出现啮齿动物侵扰。 [10.1017/s0950268826102313]

在 782 例疑似病例中,103 例(13.2%)检测呈阳性。积极性从2024年的4.2%增加到2025年的8.9%和2026年的16.1%。积极性在2月份最高(30.3%),在4月份最低(2.4%)。2024 年,中位周转时间为 4 天(IQR 4-8),2025 年为 12 天(IQR 7-43),2026 年为 2 天(IQR 1-4)。Makurdi LGA 提供了 85.0% 的样本(阳性率为 13.5%),21 个 LGA 中有 14 个没有记录到阳性病例。 [10.21203/rs.3.rs-11455388/v1]
全年都有病例发生,十一月至四月期间病例发生频率增加。 [10.1371/journal.pone.0363052]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Both MACV strains caused severe multisystemic disease consistent with BHF, often resulting in fatality. The lineage III strain resulted in uniform lethality in both NHP species, while the lineage VIII strain resulted in uniform lethality in AGM. [10.1128/mbio.02195-26]

VLPdEm5 mRNA-LNP elicited rapid, high-titer binding antibodies with broad cross-reactivity across six major LASV lineages, robust germinal center B-cell activity, and memory T-cell responses. Crucially, it provided dose-dependent protection against pseudovirus challenge in vivo. [10.1016/j.virs.2026.11.018]
The investigation concluded that the risk to others was low, and the case was attributed to a recent rodent infestation in the household. [10.1017/s0950268826102313]

Of 782 suspected cases, 103 (13.2%) tested positive. Positivity increased from 4.2% in 2024 to 8.9% in 2025 and 16.1% in 2026. Positivity was highest in February (30.3%) and lowest in April (2.4%). papers.title: Pathogenesis and natural history of Machupo virus infection in nonhuman primates.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: The mammarenavirus Machupo virus (MACV) is the causative agent of Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF) and is associated with high mortality rates in humans and nonhuman primates (NHPs). There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments to combat BHF. As there are eight genetically distinct lineages of MACV, medical countermeasures are needed to protect against all strains within these lineages. While rodent models have been developed for a few strains of MACV, NHPs most faithfully reproduce human disease. However, NHP models have only been described for two strains of MACV. Here, we assessed the pathogenic potential of two genetically distinct strains of MACV representing two different lineages in cynomolgus and/or African green monkeys (AGM). Both MACV strains caused severe multisystemic disease consistent with BHF, often resulting in fatality with the lineage III strain resulting in uniform lethality in both NHP species and the lineage VIII strain resulting in uniform lethality in AGM. Pathology was consistent among the MACV strains and NHP species with primary involvement of the gastrointestinal and lymphoid systems with the central nervous system showing variable but widespread dissemination of MACV antigen. Spatial proteomics showed that MACV antigen was most prevalent in neurons (MAP2+) and Purkinje cells (MAP2+/Calbindin+). Multi-omics assessment of circulating mRNA and proteins showed the overall phenotype of BHF was similar between species; however, the magnitude of the inflammatory response diverged at late timepoints. Overall, MACV infection of NHP recapitulated BHF in humans driven by a dysregulated innate response resulting in vascular inflammation and hemodynamic instability. IMPORTANCE: Machupo virus (MACV) is a deadly and understudied mammarenavirus that causes severe disease known as Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF) with high mortality rates in symptomatic humans. MACV is transmitted to humans by contact with the vesper mouse and has significant outbreak potential. No licensed vaccine or antivirals against MACV exist. Well-characterized animal models are critically needed to test the efficacy of promising candidate medical countermeasures against MACV and to understand how MACV causes disease. Here, we developed several new nonhuman primate models that accurately reproduced human BHF. We utilized spatial proteomics to reveal specific cell types involved in MACV infection, including those within the central nervous system, and employed a multi-omics approach to reveal circulating mRNA and protein biomarkers driving fatal disease outcomes. Our comprehensive investigation of the response to MACV infection in a highly translational species can be exploited to develop new countermeasures to combat BHF.

Machupo virus is a deadly mammarenavirus associated with high mortality rates in humans and nonhuman primates, and no licensed vaccines or antivirals exist.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized cynomolgus and African green monkeys (AGM) to assess the pathogenic potential of two MACV strains representing different lineages. The study was conducted to understand the disease in a highly translational species.
analysis.methods: The study employed spatial proteomics to reveal specific cell types involved in MACV infection, including neurons and Purkinje cells, and a multi-omics approach to reveal circulating mRNA and protein biomarkers driving fatal disease outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Both MACV strains caused severe multisystemic disease consistent with BHF, often resulting in fatality. The lineage III strain resulted in uniform lethality in both NHP species, while the lineage VIII strain resulted in uniform lethality in AGM. Pathology was consistent among the MACV strains and NHP species with primary involvement of the gastrointestinal and lymphoid systems, and the central nervous system showed variable but widespread dissemination of MACV antigen. Multi-omics assessment showed a similar overall phenotype of BHF between species but a divergent inflammatory response at late timepoints.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided new insights into the pathogenesis and natural history of Machupo virus infection in NHPs, demonstrating the utility of these models for testing medical countermeasures against BHF. The findings revealed specific cell types involved in infection and circulating biomarkers driving fatal outcomes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of new countermeasures to combat BHF and improve understanding of how Machupo virus causes disease. The NHP models accurately reproduced human BHF, providing a valuable tool for medical countermeasure testing.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of only two MACV strains and two NHP species, which may not fully represent the genetic diversity of the virus. The findings are supported by comprehensive multi-omics and spatial proteomics approaches.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the pathogenic potential of two Machupo virus strains in nonhuman primates, demonstrating severe multisystemic disease consistent with Bolivian hemorrhagic fever. The findings provide new insights into the pathogenesis of Machupo virus infection and can inform the development of medical countermeasures against BHF.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the pathogenic potential of two genetically distinct strains of Machupo virus (MACV) in nonhuman primates (NHPs) to better understand Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF) and develop medical countermeasures. Machupo virus is a deadly mammarenavirus associated with high mortality rates in humans and nonhuman primates, and no licensed vaccines or antivirals exist.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study utilized cynomolgus and African green monkeys (AGM) to assess the pathogenic potential of two MACV strains representing different lineages. The study was conducted to understand the disease in a highly translational species.
analysis_en.methods: The study employed spatial proteomics to reveal specific cell types involved in MACV infection, including neurons and Purkinje cells, and a multi-omics approach to reveal circulating mRNA and protein biomarkers driving fatal disease outcomes.
analysis_en.main_results: Both MACV strains caused severe multisystemic disease consistent with BHF, often resulting in fatality. The lineage III strain resulted in uniform lethality in both NHP species, while the lineage VIII strain resulted in uniform lethality in AGM. Pathology was consistent among the MACV strains and NHP species with primary involvement of the gastrointestinal and lymphoid systems, and the central nervous system showed variable but widespread dissemination of MACV antigen. Spatial proteomics showed that MACV antigen was most prevalent in neurons and Purkinje cells. Multi-omics assessment showed a similar overall phenotype of BHF between species but a divergent inflammatory response at late timepoints.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study provided new insights into the pathogenesis and natural history of Machupo virus infection in NHPs, demonstrating the utility of these models for testing medical countermeasures against BHF. The findings revealed specific cell types involved in infection and circulating biomarkers driving fatal outcomes.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of new countermeasures to combat BHF and improve understanding of how Machupo virus causes disease. The NHP models accurately reproduced human BHF, providing a valuable tool for medical countermeasure testing.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of only two MACV strains and two NHP species, which may not fully represent the genetic diversity of the virus. The findings are supported by comprehensive multi-omics and spatial proteomics approaches.

papers.title_zh: 发病机制 和非人类灵长类动物马丘波病毒感染的自然史。
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: The mammarenavirus Machupo virus (MACV) is the causative agent of Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF) and is associated with high mortality rates in humans and nonhuman primates (NHPs). There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments to combat BHF. As there are eight genetically distinct lineages of MACV, medical countermeasures are needed to protect against all strains within these lineages. While rodent models have been developed for a few strains of MACV, NHPs most faithfully reproduce human disease. However, NHP models have only been described for two strains of MACV. Here, we assessed the pathogenic potential of two genetically distinct strains of MACV representing two different lineages in cynomolgus and/or African green monkeys (AGM). Both MACV strains caused severe multisystemic disease consistent with BHF, often resulting in fatality with the lineage III strain resulting in uniform lethality in both NHP species and the lineage VIII strain resulting in uniform lethality in AGM. Pathology was consistent among the MACV strains and NHP species with primary involvement of the gastrointestinal and lymphoid systems with the central nervous system showing variable but widespread dissemination of MACV antigen. Spatial proteomics showed that MACV antigen was most prevalent in neurons (MAP2+) and Purkinje cells (MAP2+/Calbindin+). Multi-omics assessment of circulating mRNA and proteins showed the overall phenotype of BHF was similar between species; however, the magnitude of the inflammatory response diverged at late timepoints. Overall, MACV infection of NHP recapitulated BHF in humans driven by a dysregulated innate response resulting in vascular inflammation and hemodynamic instability. IMPORTANCE: Machupo virus (MACV) is a deadly and understudied mammarenavirus that causes severe disease known as Bolivian hemorrhagic fever (BHF) with high mortality rates in symptomatic humans. MACV is transmitted to humans by contact with the vesper mouse and has significant outbreak potential. No licensed vaccine or antivirals against MACV exist. Well-characterized animal models are critically needed to test the efficacy of promising candidate medical countermeasures against MACV and to understand how MACV causes disease. Here, we developed several new nonhuman primate models that accurately reproduced human BHF. We utilized spatial proteomics to reveal specific cell types involved in MACV infection, including those within the central nervous system, and employed a multi-omics approach to reveal circulating mRNA and protein biomarkers driving fatal disease outcomes. Our comprehensive investigation of the response to MACV infection in a highly translational species can be exploited to develop new countermeasures to combat BHF.

papers.title: Evaluation of Lassa fever surveillance system in Edo State, Nigeria (2024–2025)
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Lassa fever is a priority disease in Nigeria. Periodic evaluation of its surveillance systems is essential to strengthen performance and ensure efficient use of limited public health resources. This study evaluated the Lassa fever surveillance system in Edo State, Nigeria. METHODS: The evaluation followed the 2001 CDC guidelines and used a cross-sectional mixed-methods design. We reviewed statewide surveillance data from 2024-2025 and selected respondents from 26 health facilities across 15 of the 18 (83.3%) local government areas (LGAs), as well as from the state surveillance unit and WHO. We assessed the surveillance system's evolution, structure, and resource availability. We analyzed surveillance data by person, place, and time and audited the data for completeness, errors, outliers, and timeliness. Case investigation forms, laboratory forms, and line lists were reviewed to assess variable usefulness and identify data gaps. Structured questionnaires were administered to 30 stakeholders, including 11 key informant interviews, to assess the system's usefulness, simplicity, acceptability, timeliness, and representativeness. Quantitative data were analyzed descriptively, while qualitative data were analyzed thematically. RESULTS: Since 1969, the Lassa fever surveillance system has evolved from sporadic paper-based reporting to a coordinated, case-based digital platform. Structurally, the system operates from the community to the national level and relies on human resources, surveillance tools, and physical and digital infrastructure. Between 2024 and 2025, 6,296 suspected Lassa fever cases were reported, of which 461 (7.3%) were confirmed, among which 69 (15.0%) died. Three LGAs, Etsako West (204; 44.3%), Esan West (95; 20.6%), and Esan North-East (79; 17.1%), accounted for 378 (82%) confirmed cases. Cases occurred year-round, with increased frequency between November and April. Data completeness exceeded 95%, while errors and outliers were both below 5%. Timeliness assessment indicated that 88.5% of laboratory results were returned within 48 hours and 91.2% of cases were notified within three days. However, 18.7% of cases presented to facilities later than one week after symptom onset. Overall, the system demonstrated strong performance across the assessed attributes. Key operational challenges included delayed or incomplete laboratory feedback, high clinician workload, reliance on Disease Surveillance and Notification Officers to complete forms, and defective electronic devices. Identified data gaps included an unclear definition of the variable "department," incomplete documentation of "date of death" and "department," and the absence of a "cause of death" variable. CONCLUSION: The Lassa fever surveillance system in Edo State is simple, acceptable, and effective for case detection and outbreak monitoring. Addressing identified operational and data quality gaps could further strengthen system efficiency, sustainability, and public health impact.

This study evaluated the Lassa fever surveillance system in Edo State, Nigeria. Methods The evaluation followed the 2001 CDC guidelines and used a cross-sectional mixed-methods design. We reviewed statewide surveillance data from 2024–2025 and selected respondents from 26 health facilities across 15 of the 18 (83.3%) local government areas (LGAs), as well as from the state surveillance unit and WHO. We assessed the surveillance system’s evolution, structure, and resource availability. We analyzed surveillance data by person, place, and time and audited the data for completeness, errors, outliers, and timeliness. Case investigation forms, laboratory forms, and line lists were reviewed to assess variable usefulness and identify data gaps. Structured questionnaires were administered to 30 stakeholders, including 11 key informant interviews, to assess the system’s usefulness, simplicity, acceptability, timeliness, and representativeness. Quantitative data were analyzed descriptively, while qualitative data were analyzed thematically. Results Since 1969, the Lassa fever surveillance system has evolved from sporadic paper-based reporting to a coordinated, case-based digital platform. Structurally, the system operates from the community to the national level and relies on human resources, surveillance tools, and physical and digital infrastructure. Between 2024 and 2025, 6,296 suspected Lassa fever cases were reported, of which 461 (7.3%) were confirmed, among which 69 (15.0%) died. Three LGAs, Etsako West (204; 44.3%), Esan West (95; 20.6%), and Esan North-East (79; 17.1%), accounted for 378 (82%) confirmed cases. Cases occurred year-round, with increased frequency between November and April. Data completeness exceeded 95%, while errors and outliers were both below 5%. Timeliness assessment indicated that 88.5% of laboratory results were returned within 48 hours and 91.2% of cases were notified within three days. However, 18.7% of cases presented to facilities later than one week after symptom onset. Overall, the system demonstrated strong performance across the assessed attributes. Key operational challenges included delayed or incomplete laboratory feedback, high clinician workload, reliance on Disease Surveillance and Notification Officers to complete forms, and defective electronic devices. Identified data gaps included an unclear definition of the variable “department,” incomplete documentation of “date of death” and “department,” and the absence of a “cause of death” variable. Conclusion The Lassa fever surveillance system in Edo State is simple, acceptable, and effective for case detection and outbreak monitoring. Addressing identified operational and data quality gaps could further strengthen system efficiency, sustainability, and public health impact.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:拉沙热 是尼日利亚的重点疾病。对其 监测 系统进行定期评估对于加强绩效并确保有效利用有限的公共卫生资源至关重要。本研究评估了尼日利亚埃多州的 拉沙热 监测 系统。方法:评估遵循 2001 年 CDC 指南并采用横断面混合方法设计。我们审查了 2024 年至 2025 年全州范围的 监测 数据,并从 18 个地方政府区域 (LGA) 中的 15 个 (83.3%) 的 26 个卫生机构以及州 监测 部门和世界卫生组织中选择了受访者。我们评估了 进化 系统的 进化、结构和资源可用性。我们按人物、地点和时间分析了 监测 数据,并审核了数据的完整性、错误、异常值和及时性。审查了病例调查表、实验室表格和线路列表,以评估变量的有用性并确定数据差距。对 30 名利益相关者进行了结构化调查问卷,包括 11 名关键知情人访谈,以评估系统的实用性、简单性、可接受性、及时性和代表性。定量数据进行描述性分析,而定性数据进行主题分析。结果:自 1969 年以来,拉沙热 监测 系统已从零星的纸质报告发展为协调的、基于案例的数字平台。从结构上讲,该系统从社区到国家层面运行,依赖于人力资源、监测 工具以及物理和数字基础设施。2024年至2025年间,报告了6,296例拉沙热疑似病例,其中确诊461例(7.3%),其中69例(15.0%)死亡。三个地方政府行政区:Etsako West(204 例;44.3%)、Esan West(95 例;20.6%)和 Esan North-East(79 例;17.1%)共确诊病例 378 例(82%)。全年都有病例发生,十一月至四月期间病例发生频率增加。数据完整性超过95%,错误率和异常值均低于5%。时效性评估显示,88.5%的实验室结果在48小时内返回,91.2%的病例在三天内通报。然而,18.7% 的病例在症状出现后一周内就诊。总体而言,该系统在评估的属性上表现出了强劲的性能。主要的运营挑战包括实验室反馈延迟或不完整、临床医生工作量大、依赖疾病 监测 和通知官员填写表格以及电子设备有缺陷。已发现的数据差距包括变量“部门”的定义不明确、“死亡日期”和“部门”的记录不完整以及缺乏“死亡原因”变量。结论:江户州的 拉沙热 监测 系统对于病例检测和 Z​​XQTERMYQXZ 监测而言简单、可接受且有效。解决已发现的运营和数据质量差距可以进一步增强系统效率、可持续性和公共卫生影响。

papers.title: Epidemiological profile and outcomes of suspected viral haemorrhagic fever and confirmed Lassa fever admissions in Adamawa State, Nigeria, 2020–2026
papers.abstract: Introduction: Nigeria reports the largest number of Lassa fever cases worldwide, but facility-level data from Adamawa State, north-eastern Nigeria, are lacking. This study describes suspected viral haemorrhagic fever (VHF) admissions, including laboratory-confirmed Lassa fever, at Modibbo Adama University Teaching Hospital, Yola (MAUTHY). Methods: We reviewed the MAUTHY isolation ward register (May 2020–April 2026) for admissions with VHF or Lassa fever recorded as a working or differential diagnosis. Case fatality was calculated among patients with known final vital status. Fisher’s exact tests, Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs) and Firth penalised logistic regression were used. Results: Of 330 admissions, 53 (16.1%) were for suspected VHF. Of 40 (75.5%) with a recorded laboratory result, 9 (22.5%) were confirmed Lassa fever. Median age was 28 years; 27 (50.9%) were male. Annual admissions were 1, 3, 12, 11, 13 and 5 in 2020–2025 and 7 in January–April 2026; 34 of 52 dated admissions (65.4%) occurred in January–April. Of 41 patients with known vital status, 15 died (case fatality 36.6%; 95% CI 23.6–51.9); 12 were transferred or had no recorded outcome. Case fatality varied between years (p=0.043) without a linear trend. Age and sex were not associated with death (30–44 vs 15–29 years: adjusted odds ratio 1.88; 95% CI 0.48–7.72). Conclusion: Suspected VHF was a frequent cause of isolation admission, with high in-hospital mortality, year-to-year variation peaking in 2024 and dry-season clustering. Few patients were laboratory-confirmed, so these findings describe suspected VHF rather than confirmed Lassa fever. Faster Lassa virus testing and complete recording of test results and outcomes are priorities.

papers.abstract_zh: 简介:尼日利亚报告的 拉沙热 病例数量是全球最多的,但缺乏尼日利亚东北部阿达马瓦州的设施级数据。本研究描述了约拉莫迪博阿达玛大学教学医院 (MAUTHY) 疑似病毒性出血热 (VHF) 入院情况,包括实验室确诊的 拉沙热。方法:我们审查了 MAUTHY 隔离病房登记册(2020 年 5 月至 2026 年 4 月),了解 VHF 或 拉沙热 的入院记录,记录为工作或差异 诊断。病死率是在已知最终生命状态的患者中计算的。使用 Fisher 精确检验、Wilson 95% 置信区间 (CI) 和 Firth 惩罚逻辑回归。结果:在 330 例入院患者中,53 例 (16.1%) 疑似 VHF。在记录了实验室结果的 40 例 (75.5%) 中,9 例 (22.5%) 被确认为 拉沙热。中位年龄为 28 岁;27 名(50.9%)为男性。2020-2025年每年招生数为1、3、12、11、13和5,2026年1-4月为7;52 例入院病例中有 34 例 (65.4%) 发生在 1 月至 4 月。在 41 名已知生命状况的患者中,15 人死亡(病死率 36.6%;95% CI 23.6–51.9);12 人被转移或没有记录结果。病死率因年份而异 (p=0.043),没有线性趋势。年龄和性别与死亡无关(30-44 岁 vs 15-29 岁:调整后优势比 1.88;95% CI 0.48-7.72)。结论:疑似 VHF 是隔离入院的常见原因,住院 死亡率 较高,逐年变化在 2024 年达到峰值,且出现旱季聚集性。很少有患者经过实验室确诊,因此这些发现描述的是疑似 VHF,而不是确诊的 拉沙热。更快的拉沙病毒检测以及完整记录检测结果和结果是首要任务。

papers.title: An ESCRT-engineered mRNA-VLP vaccine elicits humoral and cellular immunity against Lassa virus.
papers.abstract: Lassa virus (LASV) causes severe hemorrhagic fever across West Africa, yet no licensed vaccine is available. A major barrier to LASV antigen design is that its sole neutralization target, the glycoprotein complex (GPC), lacks intrinsic late-domain motifs required to engage the host ESCRT machinery for particle release. Here, we report a rational design strategy that confers autonomous budding capacity to LASV GPC by appending a synthetic ESCRT-recruitment cassette to its cytoplasmic domain. Systematic screening of a sixteen-construct matrix identified a lead candidate, VLPdEm5. This construct integrates the ESCRT cassette, an optimized furin cleavage site, and a heterologous H1N1 transmembrane-cytoplasmic domain to support efficient particle assembly and proper display of conformational neutralizing epitopes. Delivered via lipid-nanoparticle-encapsulated mRNA (mRNA-LNP), VLPdEm5 drives efficient in situ virus-like particle (VLP) self-assembly, eliciting rapid, high-titer binding antibodies with broad cross-reactivity across six major LASV lineages, robust germinal center B-cell activity, and memory T-cell responses. Crucially, VLPdEm5 mRNA-LNP provides dose-dependent protection against pseudovirus challenge in vivo. This work establishes an effective LASV vaccine candidate and validates an ESCRT-engineered mRNA-VLP platform broadly applicable to non-budding viral envelope proteins.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决拉沙病毒(LASV)缺乏获得许可的 疫苗 问题,该病毒在西非引起严重出血热。该研究试图开发一种合理的设计策略,通过附加合成的 ESCRT 招募盒来赋予 LASV GPC 自主出芽能力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及合理的设计策略,利用 mRNA-LNP 递送来设计 疫苗 候选药物 VLPdEm5。该设计在体外和体内进行了测试,重点关注 LASV 抗原设计挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用系统筛选构建体来鉴定主要候选者 VLPdEm5,它整合了 ESCRT 盒、优化的弗林蛋白酶切割位点和异源 H1N1 跨膜胞质结构域。该候选物通过 mRNA-LNP 传递,以驱动有效的原位 VLP 自组装。
elements_zh.main_results: VLPdEm5 mRNA-LNP 引发快速、高滴度的结合抗体,在六种主要 LASV 谱系中具有广泛的交叉反应性、强大的生发中心 B 细胞活性和记忆 T 细胞反应。至关重要的是,它提供了针对体内假病毒攻击的剂量依赖性保护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,VLPdEm5 建立了有效的 LASV 疫苗 候选者,并验证了 ESCRT 工程设计的 mRNA-VLP 平台,广泛适用于非出芽病毒包膜蛋白。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为其他非出芽病毒包膜蛋白的 疫苗 的开发提供信息,并为针对 LASV 的 疫苗 设计提供新方法。该研究强调了 mRNA-LNP 技术在产生针对 LASV 的保护性免疫力方面的潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括在体内使用假病毒攻击,这可能无法完全代表自然感染的复杂性。由于依赖体外和体内模型而没有直接的人体试验,因此证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 拉沙病毒 (LASV) 在整个西非引起严重的出血热,但尚无获得许可的 疫苗。LASV 抗原设计的一个主要障碍是其唯一的中和靶点,即糖蛋白复合物 (GPC),缺乏与 宿主 ESCRT 机制进行颗粒释放所需的内在后域基序。在这里,我们报告了一种合理的设计策略,通过将合成的 ESCRT 招募盒附加到其细胞质结构域,赋予 LASV GPC 自主出芽能力。对 16 个构建体矩阵的系统筛选确定了主要候选者 VLPdEm5。该构建体集成了 ESCRT 盒、优化的弗林蛋白酶切割位点和异源 H1N1 跨膜胞质结构域,以支持有效的颗粒组装和构象中和表位的正确展示。VLPdEm5 通过脂质纳米颗粒封装的 mRNA (mRNA-LNP) 传递,驱动有效的原位病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 自组装,引发快速、高滴度的结合抗体,在六种主要 LASV 谱系中具有广泛的交叉反应性、强大的生发中心 B 细胞活性和记忆 T 细胞反应。至关重要的是,VLPdEm5 mRNA-LNP 提供了针对体内假病毒攻击的剂量依赖性保护。这项工作建立了一种有效的 LASV 疫苗 候选药物,并验证了 ESCRT 工程设计的 mRNA-VLP 平台,广泛适用于非出芽病毒包膜蛋白。

papers.title: Public health response to the first reported human case of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus infection in the United Kingdom since the 1950s
papers.abstract: Abstract The rodent-borne lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) was identified by metagenomic sequencing of cerebrospinal fluid from an immunocompromised 60-year-old individual. The household had recently had a rodent infestation and though environmental home sampling was negative for LCMV, this was assessed as the most likely source. Our investigations suggested the risk to others was low. Increasing availability of clinical metagenomics may help identify more cases in the future. We recommend a proportionate public health response, focusing on those vulnerable to severe disease.

papers.title: A Mathematical Model of Dengue and Lassa Fever Co-Infection with Education and Vector Control
papers.abstract: Dengue and Lassa fever co-circulate in Nigeria, yet few models examine their co-infection alongside behavioural and clinical interventions. This study develops a deterministic compartmental model of dengue–Lassa fever co-infection that couples human, mosquito and rodent dynamics and distinguishes educated from uneducated susceptible individuals. We derive the basic and effective reproduction numbers using the next-generation operator approach, and establish local and global stability of the disease-free equilibrium via a Lyapunov function, together with global stability of the endemic equilibria using a Goh–Volterra function. Sensitivity analysis identifies the parameters that most strongly influence transmission, and the model is calibrated against Nigerian surveillance data. Numerical simulations confirm the analytical results and show that public education, reduced human–vector contact and treatment of co-infected cases lower infection levels.

papers.title: Community Engagement and Involvement in Lassa Fever Control: Implementation, Governance, and Community Outcomes in Selected Districts in Sierra Leone
papers.abstract: This study examined the factors influencing the effectiveness of institutional and community support systems, focusing on guidance and counselling services in secondary schools and Community Engagement and Involvement (CEI) in Lassa fever control in Sierra Leone. The guidance and counselling component employed a mixed-methods cross-sectional design involving 128 respondents from selected secondary schools in Pujehun District. Data were collected through questionnaires and interviews and analysed using descriptive statistics, multiple linear regression, and qualitative analysis. Findings revealed inadequate counselling infrastructure, weak professional capacity, and substantial barriers, including inadequate materials (74.2%), high pupil–counsellor ratios (71.8%), lack of trained counsellors (69.4%), socioeconomic constraints (68.0%), and limited technology (67.2%). Monitoring and follow-up showed the strongest association with career development (β = 0.165, p = .073), although no individual availability or professional-capacity variable significantly predicted career development (p > .05). The CEI component demonstrated significant differences in the depth and quality of community engagement between Lower Bambara and Njaluahun. Training coverage was higher in Lower Bambara (73.0% vs. 55.4%; χ2 = 4.4, p = .037), while co-production was substantially greater (63.5% vs. 28.6%; χ2 = 17.8, p < .001). Lower Bambara also recorded higher effectiveness (median 13.5 vs. 9.0; p < .001), trust (median 13.0 vs. 11.0; p < .001), surveillance cooperation, and timely case reporting. Qualitative findings highlighted trusted local intermediaries, bidirectional communication, and co-production as important mechanisms. The findings demonstrate that formal availability of services or structures alone does not guarantee effectiveness. Sustainable outcomes require adequately trained personnel, sufficient resources, institutional support, regular and responsive implementation, meaningful participation, and strong local ownership. Strengthening professional capacity, infrastructure, monitoring systems, community co-production, trusted communication, and institutional support is therefore essential for improving both educational counselling and community-based public health interventions in Sierra Leone.

papers.title: Diagnostic yield and positivity trends of RT-PCR testing for suspected Lassa fever in North-Central Nigeria, 2024–2026: a retrospective laboratory-based study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Lassa fever (LF) is endemic in Nigeria, and RT-PCR is the reference method for confirming suspected cases. Little is known about the diagnostic yield of RT-PCR and recent positivity trends in North-Central Nigeria. This study assessed the diagnostic yield, positivity trends, turnaround time and geographic distribution of RT-PCR results among suspected LF cases and their implications for surveillance efficiency. Methods A retrospective laboratory-based analysis of RT-PCR results was conducted for 782 suspected LF cases tested between 2024 and 2026 at Federal Medical Centre Makurdi, in North-Central Nigeria. Diagnostic yield (proportion of suspected cases testing positive) and positivity rates by year, month and local government area (LGA) were calculated with 95% confidence intervals, and turnaround time from sample collection to testing was summarised as median and interquartile range (IQR). Results Of 782 suspected cases, 103 (13.2%; 95% CI 11.0–15.7) tested positive. Positivity increased from 4.2% in 2024 to 8.9% in 2025 and 16.1% in 2026 (chi-square test for trend, p = 0.002). Positivity was highest in February (30.3%) and lowest in April (2.4%). Median turnaround time was 4 days (IQR 4–8) in 2024, 12 days (IQR 7–43) in 2025 and 2 days (IQR 1–4) in 2026. Makurdi LGA supplied 85.0% of samples (positivity 13.5%); 14 of 21 LGAs recorded no positive cases, most with few samples. Conclusions About one in eight suspected LF cases was RT-PCR positive, with rising positivity from 2024 to 2026, a dry-season peak and shorter turnaround time in 2026. Positivity estimates outside the main testing centre were unstable. Broader sampling, consistently short turnaround times and seasonally informed testing could improve LF surveillance efficiency in the region.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 拉沙热(LF)在尼日利亚流行,RT-PCR是确认疑似病例的参考方法。人们对 RT-PCR 的诊断率和尼日利亚中北部最近的阳性趋势知之甚少。本研究评估了疑似 LF 病例中 RT-PCR 结果的诊断率、阳性趋势、周转时间和地理分布及其对 监测 效率的影响。方法 对 2024 年至 2026 年间在尼日利亚中北部马库迪联邦医疗中心检测的 782 例疑似 LF 病例进行了基于实验室的 RT-PCR 结果回顾性分析。以 95% 置信区间计算按年、月和地方政府区域 (LGA) 划分的诊断率(疑似病例检测呈阳性的比例)和阳性率,并将从样本采集到检测的周转时间总结为中位数和四分位距 (IQR)。结果 在 782 例疑似病例中,103 例(13.2%;95% CI 11.0–15.7)检测呈阳性。积极性从 2024 年的 4.2% 增加到 2025 年的 8.9% 和 2026 年的 16.1%(趋势卡方检验,p = 0.002)。积极性在 2 月份最高(30.3%),在 4 月份最低(2.4%)。2024 年,中位周转时间为 4 天(IQR 4-8),2025 年为 12 天(IQR 7-43),2026 年为 2 天(IQR 1-4)。Makurdi LGA 提供了 85.0% 的样本(阳性率为 13.5%);21 个地方政府管辖区中有 14 个没有记录到阳性病例,大多数样本很少。结论 大约八分之一的疑似 LF 病例呈 RT-PCR 阳性,2024 年至 2026 年阳性率不断上升,2026 年出现旱季高峰,周转时间较短。主要检测中心以外的阳性率估计不稳定。更广泛的采样、持续较短的周转时间和季节性通知测试可以提高该地区 LF 监测 的效率。

papers.title: Beyond Viral Pathogenesis: Climate Change, Zoonotic Spillover, and the Evolving Epidemiology of Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers
papers.abstract: Viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHFs) represent a major global health threat because they can cause severe systemic illness, hemorrhage, multiorgan dysfunction, and death. Ebola virus, Marburg virus, Lassa virus, and Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever virus contribute substantially to the global burden of these diseases. These pathogens employ diverse transmission routes, including vector-borne transmission, zoonotic spillover, and direct exposure to infected bodily fluids. Climate change, land use alterations, urbanization, population growth, and increased human–animal interactions may reshape pathogen ecology and create new opportunities for viral emergence and transmission. International travel and interconnected human populations further complicate outbreak containment. This review examines the pathophysiological mechanisms, epidemiological patterns, and major outbreaks associated with VHFs, with particular emphasis on how environmental change, ecological disruption, and infectious disease dynamics interact. We also evaluate the roles of global health organizations in strengthening disease surveillance, coordinating outbreak responses, and promoting international preparedness. Furthermore, we discuss the importance of integrated surveillance systems, cross-sectoral collaboration, and climate-informed public health strategies in reducing the risks associated with emerging and recurring VHF outbreaks. By integrating virological, ecological, epidemiological, and public health perspectives, this review highlights critical knowledge gaps and identifies priorities for improving early detection, outbreak preparedness, and coordinated responses to future VHF threats.

papers.title: METTL8 orchestrates TFH cell differentiation through m3C-mediated TCF1 regulation in infection and cancer models
papers.abstract: T follicular helper (TFH) cells are critical for humoral immunity against infections and correlate with immunotherapy efficacy, whereas immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy can drive their aberrant expansion, underscoring the need to understand the regulators controlling TFH cell fate. However, the epitranscriptomic regulation of their differentiation remains poorly understood. Here, we identify the 3-methylcytosine (m3C) methyltransferase METTL8 as a key regulator of TFH cell differentiation in both viral infection and cancer. METTL8 was preferentially expressed in CXCL13hi TFH cells, and its deficiency impaired TFH differentiation and germinal center responses in the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus infection model and following anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in tumor models. Mechanistically, METTL8 exerted dual functions: it bound and stabilized Tcf7 mRNA through m3C modification, and it interacted with TCF1 protein to regulate chromatin accessibility and 3D genome organization at key TFH-associated loci, including Cxcr5 and Il6ra. Notably, ginkgolic acid treatment suppressed TFH responses without compromising the antitumor efficacy of anti-PD-1 therapy, an effect associated with METTL8. Collectively, our findings identify METTL8 as an epitranscriptomic regulator linked to RNA modification, TCF1-associated transcriptional control, and chromatin architecture during TFH differentiation and suggest that modulation of this pathway may provide a strategy to tune TFH-driven immune responses.

papers.abstract_zh: 滤泡辅助性 T (TFH) 细胞对于抵抗感染的体液免疫至关重要,并且与免疫治疗效果相关,而免疫检查点抑制剂治疗可以驱动其异常扩张,这强调了了解控制 TFH 细胞命运的调节因子的必要性。然而,它们分化的表观转录组调控仍然知之甚少。在这里,我们确定 3-甲基胞嘧啶 (m3C) 甲基转移酶 METTL8 是病毒感染和癌症中 TFH 细胞分化的关键调节因子。METTL8 优先在 CXCL13hi TFH 细胞中表达,其缺陷会损害 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 感染模型和肿瘤模型中抗 PD-1 免疫治疗后的 TFH 分化和生发中心反应。从机制上讲,METTL8 发挥双重功能:它通过 m3C 修饰结合并稳定 Tcf7 mRNA,并与 TCF1 蛋白相互作用,调节关键 TFH 相关位点(包括 Cxcr5 和 Il6ra)的染色质可及性和 3D 基因组 组织。值得注意的是,银杏酸 治疗 抑制 TFH 反应,而不损害抗 PD-1 疗法的抗肿瘤功效,这是与 METTL8 相关的效果。总的来说,我们的研究结果将 METTL8 确定为与 TFH 分化过程中的 RNA 修饰、TCF1 相关转录控制和染色质结构相关的表观转录组调节因子,并表明对该途径的调节可能提供一种调节 TFH 驱动的 免疫应答 的策略。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用病毒感染(淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒)和癌症模型(抗PD-1免疫疗法)来研究METTL8在TFH细胞分化中的作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员利用基因表达分析、染色质可及性测定和 3D 基因组 组织研究,通过 m3C 修饰确定 METTL8 是 TFH 细胞分化的关键调节因子。
analysis_zh.main_results: METTL8 优先在 CXCL13hi TFH 细胞中表达,其缺陷会损害 淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒 感染模型中以及肿瘤模型中的抗 PD-1 免疫治疗后的 TFH 分化和生发中心反应。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,METTL8 发挥双重功能:它通过 m3C 修饰结合并稳定 Tcf7 mRNA,并与 TCF1 蛋白相互作用以调节染色质可及性和 3D 基因组 组织,突出了其在 TFH 分化中的作用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,METTL8 通路的调节可能提供一种调节 TFH 驱动的 免疫应答 的策略,从而有可能改善治疗结果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用动物模型以及需要在人类样本中进一步验证,这可能会限制研究结果的普遍性。

papers.title: The transcription factor TOX maintains stemness circuits that sustain longevity and multipotency of progenitor CD4+ T cells in chronic infection.
papers.abstract: Progenitor CD4 + T (Tpex) cells retain developmental plasticity and replenish antigen-specific CD4 + T cell responses in settings of chronic infection and cancer. Given the sustained, elevated expression of the transcription factor TOX across all CD4 + T EX cell subsets during chronic infection, we examined how TOX impacts CD4 + T EX differentiation during chronic infection. Deletion of TOX in lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV)-specific transgenic CD4 + T cells impaired Tpex cell survival and drove unrestrained T EX cell differentiation. Multiomic profiling revealed that this effector-like state was concomitant with loss of TCF-1 pathway activity and gain of NFAT, NF-κB, and RUNX-coordinated transcriptional circuitry. TOX also promoted the multipotent potential of CD4 + Tpex cells to differentiate into T helper (Th)1-like or Tfh-like cells by day 8 post-infection (p.i.) prior to establishment of chronic infection. These data reveal a TOX-driven transcriptional network that maintains CD4 + Tpex cell function and persistence, supporting a durable and malleable response during persisting antigen stimulation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how the transcription factor TOX influences the maintenance of stemness circuits in progenitor CD4+ T cells during chronic infection, as these cells retain developmental plasticity and replenish antigen-specific responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved examining the impact of TOX deletion in LCMV-specific transgenic CD4+ T cells during chronic infection, with a focus on their survival and differentiation patterns.
analysis.methods: TOX deletion was induced in LCMV-specific transgenic CD4+ T cells, and multiomic profiling was used to analyze changes in transcriptional circuitry associated with effector-like states.
analysis.main_results: Multiomic profiling showed that TOX deletion led to an effector-like state characterized by loss of TCF-1 pathway activity and increased NFAT, NF-κB, and RUNX-coordinated transcriptional circuitry.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that TOX maintains a transcriptional network that supports the function and persistence of CD4+ Tpex cells, enabling a durable and adaptable response during prolonged antigen exposure.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the mechanisms that sustain CD4+ T cell responses in chronic infections, which could inform strategies for enhancing immune persistence and therapeutic interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to transgenic CD4+ T cells and does not account for natural infection dynamics, but the evidence is strong due to the direct manipulation and multiomic analysis of TOX's role.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of the transcription factor TOX in maintaining the stemness circuits of progenitor CD4+ T cells during chronic infection. The research highlights that TOX is crucial for sustaining the function and persistence of these cells, which retain developmental plasticity and replenish antigen-specific responses. Using LCMV-specific transgenic CD4+ T cells, the study demonstrates that TOX deletion impairs Tpex cell survival and drives unrestrained differentiation. Multiomic profiling reveals that this effector-like state is associated with the loss of TCF-1 pathway activity and the gain of NFAT, NF-κB, and RUNX-coordinated transcriptional circuitry. The findings suggest that TOX supports a durable and malleable immune response during prolonged antigen exposure, offering potential implications for understanding immune persistence in chronic infections. However, the study is limited to transgenic models and does not account for natural infection dynamics, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

2024)。在西非,感染范围从未被识别的疾病到严重疾病和死亡(Bausch et al., 2001; 改造蛋白质?欢迎了解精准多样性散点突变基因 (SOLD) 文库>> 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 拉沙热于1969年在尼日利亚被识别,并于1970年得到临床描述(Frame et al., 1970; World Health Organization, 2024)。在西非,感染范围从未被识别的疾病到严重疾病和死亡(Bausch et al., 2001; Ogbu et al., 2007; Asogun et al., 2019)。尼日利亚的疫情暴发需要检测、隔离、临床护理、接触者追踪、感染预防和社区沟通(Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。在缺乏充分防护措施的医疗环境中也会发生传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995)。人类主要通过被感染的多乳鼠(尤其是Mastomys natalensis)尿液或粪便污染的食物、家庭表面或物品获得感染(Monath et al., 1974; Lecompte et al., 2006; World Health Organization, 2024)。直接接触感染体液可实现人际传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995; McCormick et al., 1987)。啮齿动物丰度、住房条件、食物储存和卫生状况决定暴露机会(Fichet-Calvet and Rogers, 2009; Bonner et al., 2007; Mari?n et al., 2019; Oliff, 1953)。预防措施包括啮齿动物管理、保护性食物储存和家庭卫生;疑似感染需及时进行临床评估。拉沙热早期症状非特异性,轻症或无症状感染可能逃逸检测(McCormick et al., 1987; Okokhere et al., 2018; World Health Organization, 2024)。临床和生态学证据表明,报告病例可能未反映拉沙病毒的全部分布(Sogoba et al., 2012)。公共卫生活动包括病例识别与转诊、实验室检测、支持性护理、感染预防、监测以及关于减少啮齿动物暴露的沟通(World Health Organization, 2024; Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些活动需要为社区预防、诊断服务和疫情应对提供资金。夸拉州是 preparedness 情景的设置地点。现有NCDC报告缺乏夸拉州特定的每周确诊病例序列用于本地参数估计(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。第52周报告记录2024年10例疑似病例且无确诊病例,2025年11例疑似病例且无确诊病例(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2024; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些计数既不能确定人类感染发病率,也不能确定宿主流行率。未被检测的传播可能反映感染有限、临床识别遗漏、检测不足或报告不全。无夸拉州特定的啮齿动物感染流行率数据。需要本地临床监测和啮齿动物采样以评估传播。因此,州级预测使用明确的比例假设应用于国家产出。拉沙热模型涉及人-啮齿动物传播(Musa et al., 2020; Bakare et al., 2020)、季节性宿主动态(Barua et al., 2021; Ibrahim and Dénes, 2021)、疫情数据拟合(Collins and Duffy, 2023)和预防成本(Peter et al., 2020; Abidemi et al., 2023; Abiola et al., 2024)。阈值和敏感性分析识别传播驱动因素,最优控制确定干预时间表(van den Driessche and Watmough, 2002; Pontryagin et al., 1962; Lenhart and Workman, 2007)。预算估计需要监测数据和本地实施成本;现有夸拉州数据支持基于情景的规划。2025年NCDC第52周报告记录全国9389例疑似病例和1148例确诊病例,并确定治疗成本、环境卫生差和意识有限为应对制约因素(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。本研究评估意识宣传和啮齿动物控制(单独及联合)相对于年度病例目标的效果,并估计准备支出。国家监测提供每周模式;指定的地理比例将国家模型产出转换为假设的夸拉州情景。实际操作估计需要本地发病率和干预价格。 **研究背景与问题** 填写信息,下载 Twist FlexPrepTM UHT文库制备试剂盒产品详细技术资料领 取 拉沙热是西非地区重要的病毒性出血热,尼日利亚自1969年发现该病以来持续面临疫情威胁。人类主要通过接触被感染的多乳鼠(Mastomys natalensis)排泄物污染的食物和家庭环境获得感染,人际传播则通过直接接触感染体液发生。夸拉州作为尼日利亚中部行政区,缺乏本地化的确诊病例序列和啮齿动物感染率数据,2024年和2025年第52周报告仅记录疑似病例而无确诊病例,这使得基于本地数据的精准防控规划面临困难。现有拉沙热数学模型虽涵盖人-啮齿动物传播、季节性宿主动态和疫情数据拟合等方向,但缺乏针对夸拉州特定情景的干预优化与预算准备分析。因此,研究人员有必要在数据有限的条件下,利用国家监测数据结合地理比例假设,构建夸拉州的规划情景,评估不同干预策略的效果并估算准备成本,为州级防控决策提供量化依据。 **研究内容与结论** 研究人员构建了一个确定性人-啮齿动物耦合传播模型,将人类分为易感者、临时保护者、暴露者、无症状感染者、有症状感染者和康复者,啮齿动物分为易感者和感染者。模型拟合2025年NCDC每周拉沙热系列数据,估计夸拉州年度负担,计算基本再生数并分解传播路径贡献,开展敏感性分析和最优控制模拟,比较意识宣传、啮齿动物控制及联合干预三种策略相对于年度病例目标的效果,并进行成本效果分析。研究得出基本再生数为2.5000,啮齿动物到人溢出传播贡献97.84%,是主要阈值通路;单独意识宣传使病例降至113.4例(减少31.00%)但未达目标,单独啮齿动物控制降至29.6例(减少82.00%)仍高于16例目标,联合干预降至7.8例和1.4例死亡(减少95.27%),达到目标;所需准备成本估计为88.3万美元,涵盖干预实施和剩余病例管理。该研究为夸拉州拉沙热防控提供了情景化的干预优先级和预算参考,强调了啮齿动物控制作为核心策略的必要性以及联合干预实现年度目标的可行性。 **关键技术方法** 研究人员采用确定性 compartmental 传播模型(S-P-E-A-I-R/Sr-Ir)描述人-啮齿动物耦合传播动力学,通过下一代矩阵法计算基本再生数(R0)并分解传播路径贡献,利用归一化前向敏感性指数识别关键参数,构建最优控制模型(基于Pontryagin最大值原理)求解时变控制策略,采用三角函数季节回归拟合NCDC每周监测数据,并基于地理比例(夸拉州16个LGA/全国107个受影响LGA)进行州级负担缩放和成本效果分析(计算ACER和ICER)。数据来源为2025年NCDC第52周全国拉沙热周报系列。 **研究结果** **3.1 解的正性与不变区域**:通过证明向量场在非负 orthant 边界上的准正性,得出系统(11)的解对所有t≥0保持非负;通过比较定理证明人类和啮齿动物种群总量分别有界于Λ/μ和Λr/μr,确定不变区域Ω。 **3.2 无病平衡点**:令感染 compartments 为零,求得无病平衡点E0的各分量表达式,其中S0=Λ(ω+μ)/[μ(ω+φ+μ)],P0=φΛ/[μ(ω+φ+μ)],Sr0=Λr/μr。 **3.3 地方病平衡点**:设所有分量正,将人类分量用感染力λ*表示,啮齿动物平衡满足Sr*=μr/β4和Ir*=(Λrβ4?μr2)/(μrβ4),存在条件为Λrβ4>μr2;代入后得到λ*的二次方程,当R0>1时模型存在唯一严格正地方病平衡点。 **3.4 基本再生数**:采用下一代矩阵法,以(E,A,I,Ir)为感染 compartments,计算得R0=Rrh+Rsh+Rah,其中啮齿动物到人通路Rrh=2.4460,有症状人际传播通路Rsh=0.0266,无症状人际传播通路Rah=0.0274,合计R0=2.5000;啮齿动物到人溢出贡献97.84%。 **3.5 无病平衡点局部稳定性**:计算E0处Jacobian矩阵的特征多项式,得特征值为?μ、?μ、?(φ+ω+μ)、?μr、β4Sr0?μr及Qh(ξ)=0的三个根;拟合参数下特征值包含一个正值149.998,表明拟合的无病平衡点不稳定;一般地,E0局部渐近稳定当且仅当β4Sr0<μr且Qh(ξ)所有根具有负实部。 **3.6 地方病平衡点局部稳定性**:将变量重排后,啮齿动物块特征多项式系数均为正,两个特征值具有负实部;康复类贡献?μ;剩余人类块由五次特征多项式描述,地方病平衡点局部渐近稳定需满足Hurwitz行列式条件a1>0、a1a2?a3>0、a1a2a3?a32?a12a4>0、Δ4>0、a5>0。 **3.7 数据拟合与规划输入**:对2025年NCDC每周疑似病例、确诊病例和确诊死亡三组序列分别拟合三角函数季节回归模型,确诊病例RMSE=8.28、MAE=5.32、MAPE=32.11%,死亡RMSE=1.93、MAE=1.44、MAPE=51.23%;以第1周计数设定初始感染状态,传播系数校准至R0=2.5000、基线1099例确诊病例和196例死亡。 **3.8 R0敏感性分析**:归一化前向敏感性指数显示Λ(+1.0000)、β1(+0.9784)、ω(+0.7996)为正敏感参数,μ(?0.9997)、μr(?0.9784)、φ(?0.7999)为负敏感参数;保护 uptake 降低R0,保护丧失增加R0。 **3.9 R0等值线分析**:β1与μr等值线显示增加溢出或降低啮齿动物死亡率升高R0;φ与ω等值线显示增加保护 uptake 降低R0而保护丧失升高R0;β1与φ等值线显示增加 uptake 降低R0但在基线溢出水平下未跨过R0=1阈值,表明需结合家庭防护与啮齿动物排除措施。 **3.10 最优控制模型**:引入u1(t)(保护性家庭行为)和u2(t)(捕鼠、啮齿动物清除和环境 sanitation)两个时变控制,构建目标泛函J,证明最优控制对存在性,推导 Hamiltonian、伴随系统和横截条件,得到最优控制的逐点最小化表达式u1*=min{1,max{0,(η1?η2)S/C1}}和u2*=min{1,max{0,[η7(Λr+Sr)+η8Ir]/C2}}。 **4 数值模拟与结果**:52周模拟显示,无额外控制基线为164.3例确诊病例和29.3例死亡;意识宣传单独干预降至113.4例(减少31.00%),未达16例目标;啮齿动物控制单独干预降至29.6例和5.3例死亡(减少82.00%),仍高于目标;联合干预降至7.8例和1.4例死亡(减少95.27%),达到目标。 **4.1 成本效果分析**:平均控制水平为ū1A=0.7700、ū2B=0.7873、ū1C=0.8350、ū2C=0.8407;地理缩放比例ρ=16/107=0.1495,州级基线为164.3例和29.3例死亡,年度目标要求90.26%的病例减少;负担指标BkS=CkS+4DkS,无控制负担为281.7;意识宣传、啮齿动物控制和联合控制的规划成本分别为16.7万、65.5万和88.0万美元,总成本分别为20.7万、66.6万和88.3万美元;联合控制达到目标的总情景成本为88.3万美元;ICER分析显示从意识宣传到啮齿动物控制的增量成本效果比为3400.1 USD/负担单位,从啮齿动物控制到联合控制为6020.7 USD/负担单位。 **讨论部分总结** 讨论部分指出,夸拉州情景将家庭防护和啮齿动物管理与年度病例、死亡和支出相联系。国家NCDC数据确定每周模式,16比107的地方政府区域比例确定预测州级总量。夸拉州在2024年和2025年第52周报告中报告了疑似但无确诊病例,因此预测基线164.3例和29.3例死亡是假设性规划负担而非观测到的州级发病率,需要本地病例监测、啮齿动物检测和报告审计来评估其适用性。88.3万美元的联合控制估计由88.0万美元规划支出和剩余病例管理成本组成,覆盖16个地方政府区域一年,既非批准拨款也非本地采购预算;实际操作估计需要环境卫生用品、教育、人员、交通、监督和临床护理的价格。实施需要夸拉州卫生部协调的技术评估,整合监测、地方政府卫生和环境健康团队及NCDC技术输入,编译疑似和确诊病例记录、检测和转诊数据、啮齿动物监测结果和本地价格,确定本地参数、优先社区和实施成本。试点项目应记录干预覆盖、支出和监测结果,包括覆盖家庭数、预防实践采纳、啮齿动物侵扰、报告和检测延迟、项目成本和确诊病例;每周监测和财务记录支持重新校准和覆盖决策。不确定性方面,季节模式拟合国家监测数据,传播参数校准至基线目标,确诊病例和死亡拟合的MAPE分别为32.11%和51.23%,限制了预测精度尤其在死亡方面;按地方政府区域数量缩放排除了人口、啮齿动物生态、诊断可及性和报告的变异;干预响应和单位成本为假设值,基线负担、目标达成和88.3万美元预算均依赖这些假设。夸拉州特定参数估计需要地理参照的确诊病例、检测分母和重复啮齿动物感染调查,社区预防实践和环境暴露测量,以及采购、人员、维护和临床记录以获取本地单位成本;多年人类和宿主数据支持季节性、干预覆盖和预算不确定性分析。 **研究结论翻译** 在国家到州缩放假设下,模型预测无额外控制时164.3例病例和29.3例死亡。年度目标要求90.26%的病例减少。意识宣传产生113.4例,啮齿动物控制29.6例,联合预防7.8例和1.4例死亡,以估计成本88.3万美元达到目标。该估计包括预防和剩余病例管理。实际操作预算需要州级病例监测、啮齿动物监测和本地价格。 打赏 展开全文 开通VIP 享海量文章 全站开放获取+解锁超过 2024)。在西非,感染范围从未被识别的疾病到严重疾病和死亡(Bausch et al., 2001; 改造蛋白质?欢迎了解精准多样性散点突变基因 (SOLD) 文库>> 为了促进科学的传播,生物通采集了这篇文章 订阅BioHot点这里解锁原文链接推送! “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 拉沙热于1969年在尼日利亚被识别,并于1970年得到临床描述(Frame et al., 1970; World Health Organization, 2024)。在西非,感染范围从未被识别的疾病到严重疾病和死亡(Bausch et al., 2001; Ogbu et al., 2007; Asogun et al., 2019)。尼日利亚的疫情暴发需要检测、隔离、临床护理、接触者追踪、感染预防和社区沟通(Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。在缺乏充分防护措施的医疗环境中也会发生传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995)。人类主要通过被感染的多乳鼠(尤其是Mastomys natalensis)尿液或粪便污染的食物、家庭表面或物品获得感染(Monath et al., 1974; Lecompte et al., 2006; World Health Organization, 2024)。直接接触感染体液可实现人际传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995; McCormick et al., 1987)。啮齿动物丰度、住房条件、食物储存和卫生状况决定暴露机会(Fichet-Calvet and Rogers, 2009; Bonner et al., 2007; Mari?n et al., 2019; Oliff, 1953)。预防措施包括啮齿动物管理、保护性食物储存和家庭卫生;疑似感染需及时进行临床评估。拉沙热早期症状非特异性,轻症或无症状感染可能逃逸检测(McCormick et al., 1987; Okokhere et al., 2018; World Health Organization, 2024)。临床和生态学证据表明,报告病例可能未反映拉沙病毒的全部分布(Sogoba et al., 2012)。公共卫生活动包括病例识别与转诊、实验室检测、支持性护理、感染预防、监测以及关于减少啮齿动物暴露的沟通(World Health Organization, 2024; Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些活动需要为社区预防、诊断服务和疫情应对提供资金。夸拉州是 preparedness 情景的设置地点。现有NCDC报告缺乏夸拉州特定的每周确诊病例序列用于本地参数估计(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。第52周报告记录2024年10例疑似病例且无确诊病例,2025年11例疑似病例且无确诊病例(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2024; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些计数既不能确定人类感染发病率,也不能确定宿主流行率。未被检测的传播可能反映感染有限、临床识别遗漏、检测不足或报告不全。无夸拉州特定的啮齿动物感染流行率数据。需要本地临床监测和啮齿动物采样以评估传播。因此,州级预测使用明确的比例假设应用于国家产出。拉沙热模型涉及人-啮齿动物传播(Musa et al., 2020; Bakare et al., 2020)、季节性宿主动态(Barua et al., 2021; Ibrahim and Dénes, 2021)、疫情数据拟合(Collins and Duffy, 2023)和预防成本(Peter et al., 2020; Abidemi et al., 2023; Abiola et al., 2024)。阈值和敏感性分析识别传播驱动因素,最优控制确定干预时间表(van den Driessche and Watmough, 2002; Pontryagin et al., 1962; Lenhart and Workman, 2007)。预算估计需要监测数据和本地实施成本;现有夸拉州数据支持基于情景的规划。2025年NCDC第52周报告记录全国9389例疑似病例和1148例确诊病例,并确定治疗成本、环境卫生差和意识有限为应对制约因素(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。本研究评估意识宣传和啮齿动物控制(单独及联合)相对于年度病例目标的效果,并估计准备支出。国家监测提供每周模式;指定的地理比例将国家模型产出转换为假设的夸拉州情景。实际操作估计需要本地发病率和干预价格。 **研究背景与问题** 填写信息,下载 Twist FlexPrepTM UHT文库制备试剂盒产品详细技术资料领 取 拉沙热是西非地区重要的病毒性出血热,尼日利亚自1969年发现该病以来持续面临疫情威胁。人类主要通过接触被感染的多乳鼠(Mastomys natalensis)排泄物污染的食物和家庭环境获得感染,人际传播则通过直接接触感染体液发生。夸拉州作为尼日利亚中部行政区,缺乏本地化的确诊病例序列和啮齿动物感染率数据,2024年和2025年第52周报告仅记录疑似病例而无确诊病例,这使得基于本地数据的精准防控规划面临困难。现有拉沙热数学模型虽涵盖人-啮齿动物传播、季节性宿主动态和疫情数据拟合等方向,但缺乏针对夸拉州特定情景的干预优化与预算准备分析。因此,研究人员有必要在数据有限的条件下,利用国家监测数据结合地理比例假设,构建夸拉州的规划情景,评估不同干预策略的效果并估算准备成本,为州级防控决策提供量化依据。 **研究内容与结论** 研究人员构建了一个确定性人-啮齿动物耦合传播模型,将人类分为易感者、临时保护者、暴露者、无症状感染者、有症状感染者和康复者,啮齿动物分为易感者和感染者。模型拟合2025年NCDC每周拉沙热系列数据,估计夸拉州年度负担,计算基本再生数并分解传播路径贡献,开展敏感性分析和最优控制模拟,比较意识宣传、啮齿动物控制及联合干预三种策略相对于年度病例目标的效果,并进行成本效果分析。研究得出基本再生数为2.5000,啮齿动物到人溢出传播贡献97.84%,是主要阈值通路;单独意识宣传使病例降至113.4例(减少31.00%)但未达目标,单独啮齿动物控制降至29.6例(减少82.00%)仍高于16例目标,联合干预降至7.8例和1.4例死亡(减少95.27%),达到目标;所需准备成本估计为88.3万美元,涵盖干预实施和剩余病例管理。该研究为夸拉州拉沙热防控提供了情景化的干预优先级和预算参考,强调了啮齿动物控制作为核心策略的必要性以及联合干预实现年度目标的可行性。 **关键技术方法** 研究人员采用确定性 compartmental 传播模型(S-P-E-A-I-R/Sr-Ir)描述人-啮齿动物耦合传播动力学,通过下一代矩阵法计算基本再生数(R0)并分解传播路径贡献,利用归一化前向敏感性指数识别关键参数,构建最优控制模型(基于Pontryagin最大值原理)求解时变控制策略,采用三角函数季节回归拟合NCDC每周监测数据,并基于地理比例(夸拉州16个LGA/全国107个受影响LGA)进行州级负担缩放和成本效果分析(计算ACER和ICER)。数据来源为2025年NCDC第52周全国拉沙热周报系列。 **研究结果** **3.1 解的正性与不变区域**:通过证明向量场在非负 orthant 边界上的准正性,得出系统(11)的解对所有t≥0保持非负;通过比较定理证明人类和啮齿动物种群总量分别有界于Λ/μ和Λr/μr,确定不变区域Ω。 **3.2 无病平衡点**:令感染 compartments 为零,求得无病平衡点E0的各分量表达式,其中S0=Λ(ω+μ)/[μ(ω+φ+μ)],P0=φΛ/[μ(ω+φ+μ)],Sr0=Λr/μr。 **3.3 地方病平衡点**:设所有分量正,将人类分量用感染力λ*表示,啮齿动物平衡满足Sr*=μr/β4和Ir*=(Λrβ4?μr2)/(μrβ4),存在条件为Λrβ4>μr2;代入后得到λ*的二次方程,当R0>1时模型存在唯一严格正地方病平衡点。 **3.4 基本再生数**:采用下一代矩阵法,以(E,A,I,Ir)为感染 compartments,计算得R0=Rrh+Rsh+Rah,其中啮齿动物到人通路Rrh=2.4460,有症状人际传播通路Rsh=0.0266,无症状人际传播通路Rah=0.0274,合计R0=2.5000;啮齿动物到人溢出贡献97.84%。 **3.5 无病平衡点局部稳定性**:计算E0处Jacobian矩阵的特征多项式,得特征值为?μ、?μ、?(φ+ω+μ)、?μr、β4Sr0?μr及Qh(ξ)=0的三个根;拟合参数下特征值包含一个正值149.998,表明拟合的无病平衡点不稳定;一般地,E0局部渐近稳定当且仅当β4Sr0<μr且Qh(ξ)所有根具有负实部。 **3.6 地方病平衡点局部稳定性**:将变量重排后,啮齿动物块特征多项式系数均为正,两个特征值具有负实部;康复类贡献?μ;剩余人类块由五次特征多项式描述,地方病平衡点局部渐近稳定需满足Hurwitz行列式条件a1>0、a1a2?a3>0、a1a2a3?a32?a12a4>0、Δ4>0、a5>0。 **3.7 数据拟合与规划输入**:对2025年NCDC每周疑似病例、确诊病例和确诊死亡三组序列分别拟合三角函数季节回归模型,确诊病例RMSE=8.28、MAE=5.32、MAPE=32.11%,死亡RMSE=1.93、MAE=1.44、MAPE=51.23%;以第1周计数设定初始感染状态,传播系数校准至R0=2.5000、基线1099例确诊病例和196例死亡。 **3.8 R0敏感性分析**:归一化前向敏感性指数显示Λ(+1.0000)、β1(+0.9784)、ω(+0.7996)为正敏感参数,μ(?0.9997)、μr(?0.9784)、φ(?0.7999)为负敏感参数;保护 uptake 降低R0,保护丧失增加R0。 **3.9 R0等值线分析**:β1与μr等值线显示增加溢出或降低啮齿动物死亡率升高R0;φ与ω等值线显示增加保护 uptake 降低R0而保护丧失升高R0;β1与φ等值线显示增加 uptake 降低R0但在基线溢出水平下未跨过R0=1阈值,表明需结合家庭防护与啮齿动物排除措施。 **3.10 最优控制模型**:引入u1(t)(保护性家庭行为)和u2(t)(捕鼠、啮齿动物清除和环境 sanitation)两个时变控制,构建目标泛函J,证明最优控制对存在性,推导 Hamiltonian、伴随系统和横截条件,得到最优控制的逐点最小化表达式u1*=min{1,max{0,(η1?η2)S/C1}}和u2*=min{1,max{0,[η7(Λr+Sr)+η8Ir]/C2}}。 **4 数值模拟与结果**:52周模拟显示,无额外控制基线为164.3例确诊病例和29.3例死亡;意识宣传单独干预降至113.4例(减少31.00%),未达16例目标;啮齿动物控制单独干预降至29.6例和5.3例死亡(减少82.00%),仍高于目标;联合干预降至7.8例和1.4例死亡(减少95.27%),达到目标。 **4.1 成本效果分析**:平均控制水平为ū1A=0.7700、ū2B=0.7873、ū1C=0.8350、ū2C=0.8407;地理缩放比例ρ=16/107=0.1495,州级基线为164.3例和29.3例死亡,年度目标要求90.26%的病例减少;负担指标BkS=CkS+4DkS,无控制负担为281.7;意识宣传、啮齿动物控制和联合控制的规划成本分别为16.7万、65.5万和88.0万美元,总成本分别为20.7万、66.6万和88.3万美元;联合控制达到目标的总情景成本为88.3万美元;ICER分析显示从意识宣传到啮齿动物控制的增量成本效果比为3400.1 USD/负担单位,从啮齿动物控制到联合控制为6020.7 USD/负担单位。 **讨论部分总结** 讨论部分指出,夸拉州情景将家庭防护和啮齿动物管理与年度病例、死亡和支出相联系。国家NCDC数据确定每周模式,16比107的地方政府区域比例确定预测州级总量。夸拉州在2024年和2025年第52周报告中报告了疑似但无确诊病例,因此预测基线164.3例和29.3例死亡是假设性规划负担而非观测到的州级发病率,需要本地病例监测、啮齿动物检测和报告审计来评估其适用性。88.3万美元的联合控制估计由88.0万美元规划支出和剩余病例管理成本组成,覆盖16个地方政府区域一年,既非批准拨款也非本地采购预算;实际操作估计需要环境卫生用品、教育、人员、交通、监督和临床护理的价格。实施需要夸拉州卫生部协调的技术评估,整合监测、地方政府卫生和环境健康团队及NCDC技术输入,编译疑似和确诊病例记录、检测和转诊数据、啮齿动物监测结果和本地价格,确定本地参数、优先社区和实施成本。试点项目应记录干预覆盖、支出和监测结果,包括覆盖家庭数、预防实践采纳、啮齿动物侵扰、报告和检测延迟、项目成本和确诊病例;每周监测和财务记录支持重新校准和覆盖决策。不确定性方面,季节模式拟合国家监测数据,传播参数校准至基线目标,确诊病例和死亡拟合的MAPE分别为32.11%和51.23%,限制了预测精度尤其在死亡方面;按地方政府区域数量缩放排除了人口、啮齿动物生态、诊断可及性和报告的变异;干预响应和单位成本为假设值,基线负担、目标达成和88.3万美元预算均依赖这些假设。夸拉州特定参数估计需要地理参照的确诊病例、检测分母和重复啮齿动物感染调查,社区预防实践和环境暴露测量,以及采购、人员、维护和临床记录以获取本地单位成本;多年人类和宿主数据支持季节性、干预覆盖和预算不确定性分析。 **研究结论翻译** 在国家到州缩放假设下,模型预测无额外控制时164.3例病例和29.3例死亡。年度目标要求90.26%的病例减少。意识宣传产生113.4例,啮齿动物控制29.6例,联合预防7.8例和1.4例死亡,以估计成本88.3万美元达到目标。该估计包括预防和剩余病例管理。实际操作预算需要州级病例监测、啮齿动物监测和本地价格。 打赏 展开全文 开通VIP 享海量文章 全站开放获取+解锁超过 source_language_evidence.time: “畅读会员”点此登录查看原文链接 Open access 拉沙热于1969年在尼日利亚被识别,并于1970年得到临床描述(Frame et al., 1970; World Health Organization, 2024)。在西非,感染范围从未被识别的疾病到严重疾病和死亡(Bausch et al., 2001; Ogbu et al., 2007; Asogun et al., 2019)。尼日利亚的疫情暴发需要检测、隔离、临床护理、接触者追踪、感染预防和社区沟通(Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。在缺乏充分防护措施的医疗环境中也会发生传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995)。人类主要通过被感染的多乳鼠(尤其是Mastomys natalensis)尿液或粪便污染的食物、家庭表面或物品获得感染(Monath et al., 1974; Lecompte et al., 2006; World Health Organization, 2024)。直接接触感染体液可实现人际传播(Fisher-Hoch et al., 1995; McCormick et al., 1987)。啮齿动物丰度、住房条件、食物储存和卫生状况决定暴露机会(Fichet-Calvet and Rogers, 2009; Bonner et al., 2007; Mari?n et al., 2019; Oliff, 1953)。预防措施包括啮齿动物管理、保护性食物储存和家庭卫生;疑似感染需及时进行临床评估。拉沙热早期症状非特异性,轻症或无症状感染可能逃逸检测(McCormick et al., 1987; Okokhere et al., 2018; World Health Organization, 2024)。临床和生态学证据表明,报告病例可能未反映拉沙病毒的全部分布(Sogoba et al., 2012)。公共卫生活动包括病例识别与转诊、实验室检测、支持性护理、感染预防、监测以及关于减少啮齿动物暴露的沟通(World Health Organization, 2024; Ajayi et al., 2013; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些活动需要为社区预防、诊断服务和疫情应对提供资金。夸拉州是 preparedness 情景的设置地点。现有NCDC报告缺乏夸拉州特定的每周确诊病例序列用于本地参数估计(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。第52周报告记录2024年10例疑似病例且无确诊病例,2025年11例疑似病例且无确诊病例(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2024; Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。这些计数既不能确定人类感染发病率,也不能确定宿主流行率。未被检测的传播可能反映感染有限、临床识别遗漏、检测不足或报告不全。无夸拉州特定的啮齿动物感染流行率数据。需要本地临床监测和啮齿动物采样以评估传播。因此,州级预测使用明确的比例假设应用于国家产出。拉沙热模型涉及人-啮齿动物传播(Musa et al., 2020; Bakare et al., 2020)、季节性宿主动态(Barua et al., 2021; Ibrahim and Dénes, 2021)、疫情数据拟合(Collins and Duffy, 2023)和预防成本(Peter et al., 2020; Abidemi et al., 2023; Abiola et al., 2024)。阈值和敏感性分析识别传播驱动因素,最优控制确定干预时间表(van den Driessche and Watmough, 2002; Pontryagin et al., 1962; Lenhart and Workman, 2007)。预算估计需要监测数据和本地实施成本;现有夸拉州数据支持基于情景的规划。2025年NCDC第52周报告记录全国9389例疑似病例和1148例确诊病例,并确定治疗成本、环境卫生差和意识有限为应对制约因素(Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, 2025)。本研究评估意识宣传和啮齿动物控制(单独及联合)相对于年度病例目标的效果,并估计准备支出。国家监测提供每周模式;指定的地理比例将国家模型产出转换为假设的夸拉州情景。实际操作估计需要本地发病率和干预价格。
